title: Buyers' promise to save Melbourne family home moves longtime owners to tears
summary_full: In a heartfelt farewell, a Melbourne couple bid adieu to their beloved Maidstone home, a cherished sanctuary for over four decades after immigrating from Lebanon in 1982. Reassured by the buyers' intention to cherish the house rather than demolish it, the couple found solace in their memories. This sale marks a poignant shift as they prepare to embrace a new chapter in Taylors Lakes.
